dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I was in Krabi with some friends.
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz ɪn ˈkrɑːbi wɪð sʌm ˈfrɛndz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It was amazing! But the beaches were very crowded. Where were you on Friday night?
dialogue.reading: ɪt wʌz əˈmeɪzɪŋ! bʌt ðə ˈbiːtʃɪz wɜːr ˈvɛri ˈkraʊdɪd. ˈwɛr wɜːr juː ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ ˈnaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I was at a concert with Fah.
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz ət ə ˈkɑːnsərt wɪð ˈfɑː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it was awful! The music was bad, and it was too crowded.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt wʌz ˈɔːfəl! ðə ˈmjuːzɪk wʌz ˈbæd, ənd ɪt wʌz ˈtuː ˈkraʊdɪd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! Next time, come to Krabi with me!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈnɛkst ˈtaɪm, ˈkʌm tə ˈkrɑːbi wɪð miː!
